person.name: Roman Mednitzer
person.headline: Senior Systems & Platform Engineer
person.summary: Roman Mednitzer is a senior systems and platform engineer based in Vienna, Austria, with around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment.
person.description: Personal website of Roman Mednitzer, a senior systems and platform engineer in Vienna. Infrastructure, AI experiments, cybernetics, science fiction and music.

person.introduction: I’m Roman, a systems and platform engineer based in Vienna. Much of what I know comes from practical work, independent study and experimentation. Professionally, I work on infrastructure integration and reliable operations. My private projects give me room to explore AI, automation and unfamiliar ideas without treating every experiment as a finished product. Beyond engineering, I’m interested in cybernetics and human augmentation, read hard science fiction, and listen to industrial and EBM music.
person.outlook: I’m interested in how technology can extend human capabilities, from AI and robotics to cybernetics and human augmentation. I enjoy ambitious ideas, but I also want to understand what works, what fails and what remains unknown. Understanding and retaining control over the systems we depend on matters to me.

featuredProjects.name: relay-shell
featuredProjects.reasonFeatured: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets compatible AI clients run shell commands and work over SSH. It supports interactive sessions, file transfers, operation records and configurable policy.
featuredProjects.boundary: Open by default; it runs with the service account’s authority and is not a sandbox.

featuredProjects.name: osint-workbench
featuredProjects.reasonFeatured: A self-hostable workbench for collecting public information, preserving evidence and searching it, with optional enrichment and read-only assistant access. It distils part of my private information-processing environment into a smaller reference implementation.
featuredProjects.boundary: Work in progress: core workflows have documented limits, with a disposable Docker Compose setup for integration testing. Full operational qualification remains open.

experience.summary: Operated mixed Windows and Linux infrastructure for business-critical applications. Maintained backup and recovery with documented restore verification, monitoring and alerting. Contributed to Kubernetes and GitOps adoption, change documentation and compliance evidence.

Progressed from junior to senior-level work in managed services. Built and operated Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms; maintained virtualisation, enterprise storage, document-database clusters and source-control and CI services. Handled production incidents and changes with documented rollback and verified restores.

Operated servers, applications and virtualisation in a regulated medical-device environment. Performed root-cause analysis, wrote runbooks and contributed to information security management, business continuity and ISO/IEC 27001 audit preparation.
Started in Linux hosting and technical support, followed by server operations, backup and recovery. Completed the Austrian vocational qualification in IT in 2016.
